verdict.rationale: Avalara's own SDK docs say it provides official SDKs for the AvaTax REST v2 APIs in six languages (C#, Java, JavaScript, Python, PHP, Ruby), and the free trial explicitly includes SDK access, so developers can build against first-party SDKs. Missing for 10: per-SDK documentation depth (installation, reference docs, code samples, maintenance status), independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Avalara provides SDKs for the REST v2 APIs in the following languages: C#, Java, JavaScript, Python, PHP, Ruby
